body:
# Rewritten SSIL logic
Addresses [Improve SSIL/SSAO](https://github.com/orgs/godotengine/projects/33/views/1?pane=issue&itemId=75874346)

The current state of Godot's SSIL can be seen as quite far behind compared to current [state of the art implementations](https://www.shadertoy.com/view/XfcBDl), and so I have rewritten the current SSIL logic to remain performant, but with a more modern, up-to-date approach. I have discussed it quite a bit [in the rendering channel](https://chat.godotengine.org/channel/rendering/thread/gpFmhr3ZxkvQ8yRad?jump=GdP0lSrmaBra0fXIw).

This approach uses visibility bitmasks, a relatively new method for screen space effects such as AO and GI, that keeps a far more accurate track of occlusion by storing visibility in a 32-bit "bitmask", with each bit representing that sector's visibility. This allows for far more appealing, accurate visuals at a relatively minimal added cost, and in the future can be easily shared between AO & GI since it is derived from [GTAO-VB](https://www.shadertoy.com/view/4cdfzf) logic. This technique has been pretty well documented and I will leave some references I used below.

The most prominent changes made are as such:


* **Rewritten SSIL logic that closely matches [this](https://www.shadertoy.com/view/XfcBDl) Shadertoy's implementation**
* **Rewritten, improved SSIL bilateral blur**
* **Easy way for future implementation of GTAO-VB at little cost**
